fields.statement: Verifier at 6e3f6571: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes; TestAutonomyDeclaration parses autonomous = true (all four stages auto), autonomous = false (all owner), a partial [autonomy] table (plan owner, ship auto, accept/signoff undeclared) and no declaration (every stage undeclared, so it follows rhiza.autonomy.<stage>) through Definition.Autonomy, and both Parse and Validate refuse both forms in one file ("autonomous and [autonomy] are both set"), an unknown stage ("autonomy.build: unknown stage"), a bad value ("autonomy.ship: maybe is not a mode") and a non-boolean autonomous, each naming the key. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/workflow-check$ passes: rhiza workflow check accepts a file with autonomous = true and exits non-zero with the same messages for a bad [autonomy] value and for both forms. Diff read: parseAutonomy runs on every load (parse) and in Validate; [autonomy] keys are excluded from the unknown-key check and checked by parseAutonomy instead.
